stories.headline: Former President Yoon Suk-yeol sentenced to life in prison for insurrection over martial law attempt
stories.summary: A Seoul court sentenced former President Yoon Suk-yeol to life imprisonment after finding him guilty of leading an insurrection when he declared martial law in December 2024. The ruling followed his failed attempt to deploy troops to the National Assembly and suppress opposition forces.

stories.headline: President Lee Jae-myung's approval ratings rise amid real estate policy disputes with opposition
stories.summary: President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating rose to 56.5 percent for the third consecutive week, driven by his stance on real estate policy. Lee has been engaged in public disputes with PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok over multi-homeowner regulations and housing market policies.

stories.headline: PPP leader urges resumption of President Lee's criminal trials amid political tensions
stories.summary: People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyeok called on the courts to resume criminal proceedings against President Lee Jae-myung, arguing that five trials involving Lee were halted before he took office. The PPP also criticized Lee's response to North Korean drone incidents and other security matters.

stories.headline: Bank of Korea expected to maintain interest rates unchanged for sixth consecutive meeting
stories.summary: The Bank of Korea is likely to keep its benchmark interest rate at 2.5 percent at its Thursday meeting, marking a sixth straight freeze. Analysts cite contained inflation near the 2 percent target and persistent financial stability concerns as reasons for the hold.

stories.headline: Brazilian President Lula begins state visit to South Korea for trade and defense summit
stories.summary: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva arrived in Seoul for a three-day state visit to meet with President Lee Jae-myung. The leaders are expected to deepen cooperation across energy, space, and defense sectors during the bilateral summit.

articles.title: Lula begins South Korea state visit, meets Lee to boost trade and defense

stories.headline: South Korea and US show differences over details of annual spring military exercises
stories.summary: South Korean and US military authorities are showing disagreements over details of the annual springtime joint exercise, with sources saying the delay came after President Lee called for measures to ease inter-Korean tensions regarding joint military activities.

articles.title: Allies differ over March joint drills amid Lee's tension-easing push: sources

stories.headline: Foreign investment in Korean stocks nearly doubles amid Kospi rally breaking records
stories.summary: Foreign ownership of Korean equities nearly doubled in 2025 as the Kospi's world-beating rally drove market value surge, with the index reaching record highs above 5,500. The rally has been driven by AI-related optimism and strong corporate earnings.
